Product Images & Colours
Product colours may vary slightly due to lighting and screen settings.
Size & Availability
Please select the correct size and colour before ordering. Availability is checked when your order is submitted.
Shopping Cart
Adding an item to your cart does not reserve stock.
Prices & Delivery Charges
The final price, applicable discount and delivery charges are displayed at checkout before you place your order.
Offers & Bargaining
Coupons are subject to their stated eligibility and validity. Bargained prices cannot be combined with additional coupons or offers and remain valid only until the displayed expiry time.
Payment Confirmation
Submitting an order does not confirm payment. After paying, please send your payment screenshot to the store on WhatsApp. Your order will be confirmed after payment verification.
Store Pickup
The required advance is displayed at checkout. Any remaining balance is payable when collecting your footwear. Unpaid reservations may expire after the displayed payment deadline.
Size Exchange

Unused and unworn footwear may be exchanged for another size within 7 days of purchase, subject to availability. The original bill and packaging are required. Cash refunds are not offered for change-of-mind returns.
Incorrect or Defective Items
Please contact the store with your order number if you receive an incorrect or defective item. These terms do not limit your rights under applicable consumer law.
Cancellations & Refunds

Once payment has been made, customer-requested cancellations and change-of-mind refunds are not accepted. This policy does not exclude remedies available under applicable law for incorrect, defective or unfulfilled orders.
Customer Information
Your name, mobile number and address are used to process your order, arrange delivery and provide order-related communication.
Contact Us
For order assistance, exchanges or payment queries, contact the store using the contact details provided in the catalog.
